tools.description: Start a marketing campaign pack on Campaign Pack's own GPUs. Produces a campaign plan, ideas, ad and social scripts, a creator brief, and a client-ready PDF — plus product stills on the image sizes. Returns immediately with a job id; the run itself takes minutes, so poll check_campaign rather than waiting. Write the brief yourself from what the user told you: the richer and more specific it is, the better the pack. Nothing is sent to any third-party model provider.

brand.description: The brand name, spelled exactly as the customer spells it. Every mention in the pack is rewritten to match this.

brief.description: What the product is, who it is for, what matters about it. A few sentences to a few paragraphs. State only facts the user gave you — invented metrics or customers end up in the finished pack.

photo.description: Workspace path from upload_product_photo. Required for the image sizes: the stills are edited from the real photo rather than generated from nothing.

size.description: Pack size. Available here: 'text' (about a minute), 'lite' (about ten minutes).

tools.name: start_campaign
tools.title: Start a campaign

tools.description: Progress of a running campaign: status, the tools it has just called, queue position, and whether it is waiting for a human approval. Poll about every 20 seconds.
tools.name: check_campaign
tools.title: Check campaign progress

tools.description: Collect a finished campaign: the folder, its files, the written overview, and the path to the PDF.
tools.name: get_pack
tools.title: Get the finished pack

tools.description: Campaigns on this account, newest first, including ones shared with it. Start here when you do not already have an id — the ids from start_campaign only exist in the conversation that made them, so this is how you find a campaign from last week.

limit.description: How many to return, newest first. Default 20.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.title: List past campaigns

tools.description: List files and folders in the account's workspace — campaign folders, scripts, product stills, PDFs, uploads. Directories end in '/'.

path.description: Folder to list, relative to the workspace. Omit or '.' for the top level.

session_id.description: Look inside a campaign shared with this account rather than its own files. Omit for your own workspace.

tools.name: list_workspace_files
tools.title: List workspace files

tools.description: Contents of a text file in the workspace — a script, the plan, the creator brief, a transcript. Large files are truncated. For a PDF, image or video call get_download_url instead.

path.description: File path relative to the workspace, as shown by list_workspace_files.

session_id.description: Read from a campaign shared with this account rather than its own files. Omit for your own workspace.

tools.name: read_workspace_file
tools.title: Read a workspace file

tools.description: A link the person can open to get one file — the campaign PDF, a product still, a video. Works for any file in the workspace, including ones too big or too binary to read as text. The link expires within the hour.

path.description: File path relative to the workspace, as shown by list_workspace_files.

session_id.description: Link a file from a campaign shared with this account rather than its own files. Omit for your own workspace.

tools.name: get_download_url
tools.title: Get a download link

tools.description: Put a product photo into the user's workspace so a campaign can edit stills from the real thing. Base64 of the image bytes.

data_base64.description: The image file's bytes, base64-encoded. The raw image, not a data: URL and not a path on your own machine.

filename.description: Name to save it under, with the extension — 'bottle.jpg'. Reusing a name that is already there replaces that photo.

tools.name: upload_product_photo
tools.title: Upload a product photo

tools.description: Give a teammate access to a campaign by email address — including while it is still running. They see the same live run from their own AI client or the website, can abort it, answer its approval prompts, and take the next turn. They must already have a Campaign Pack account; sharing does not create one.

email.description: Email address of the person to let in. They must already have a Campaign Pack account under this address; sharing does not create one or send an invitation.

session_id.description: Campaign to act on — the session id from start_campaign or check_campaign.

tools.name: share_campaign
tools.title: Share a campaign

tools.description: Who owns a campaign and who it is shared with.

session_id.description: Campaign to act on — the session id from start_campaign or check_campaign.

tools.name: list_campaign_access
tools.title: List who can see a campaign

tools.description: Revoke a collaborator's access. Takes effect on their next request.

email.description: Email address of the collaborator to remove. The owner cannot be removed this way.

session_id.description: Campaign to act on — the session id from start_campaign or check_campaign.

tools.name: unshare_campaign
tools.title: Remove someone's access

tools.description: Answer a paused run that wants to send the user's data somewhere outside Campaign Pack. Ask the person; never decide for them.

decision.description: What the person said: 'allow' to let the run go ahead, 'refuse' to deny it. This must be their answer, not yours.

tools.name: answer_approval
tools.title: Answer an approval prompt
